urdu: پروفیسر وسنت شندے کے مطابق تندوری چکن کے ابتدائی شواہد کس تہذیب میں ملے ہیں؟
english: According to Professor Vasant Shinde, in which civilization were the early evidences of Tandoori Chicken found?
roman_1: Professor Vasant Shinde ke mutabiq tandoori chicken ke ibtidaai shawaahid kis tehzeeb mein mile hain?
roman_2: Professor Vasant Shinde kay mutabiq tandori chicken ke ibtidaai shawaahid kis tehzeeb main milay hain?
roman_3: Professor Vasant Shinde ke mutabiq tandori chicken ke ibtidaayi shawaahid kis tehzeeb me mile hain?
